title: MIRA
tagline: MIRA is rebuilding financial access for women in crisis—without documents, gas, or exposure.
description: MIRA Sanctuary is a Web3-powered micro-finance platform that gives women fleeing crisis a private, on-chain identity and gas-free USD-pegged wallet. Using zero-knowledge attestations (age, country, sanctions) and optional NGO verification, it issues a non-transferable “SafeID” NFT, then enables instant, rules-bound USDC donations or micro-grants (only at vetted merchants, with panic-freeze protection). All transactions are transparent and auditable, yet users’ personal data remains encrypted and in their control.
how_its_made:
MIRA is a privacy-first Web3 platform that gives women in crisis a path to rebuild their lives — with dignity, security, and financial access.

We integrated three powerful protocols to solve real-world problems:

1. Self.xyz — Zero-Knowledge Identity
Verifies facts (like age or region) without exposing personal data.
Uses ZK proofs to confirm eligibility (18+, non-sanctioned)
No documents uploaded, no identity revealed
Verified via a QR + passport scan inside the user’s mobile device

2. Circle — Gasless Wallets with USDC
Institutional-grade security, consumer-grade simplicity.
Auto-generates a secure MPC wallet upon verification
No seed phrases, no gas fees — fully sponsored
Uses USDC for stable, predictable aid transfers

3. The Graph — Reputation from On-Chain Actions
Progress becomes proof.
Tracks aid disbursements and engagement
Builds a dynamic “reputation score” through a custom subgraph
Unlocks access to further support, jobs, or training
